title: Unexplained mass caught as rockets destroyed

tellings.quote: a an unexplained mass that was actually documented in tandem with the rockets being destroyed in some of those launches above the triangle,

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, says that during rocket launches above a part of the ranch called "the triangle," some of the rockets were destroyed, and at the same moment an unexplained mass was recorded. The owner speaks as someone involved in the work there, and if true it would mean something unseen in the air over the ranch was picked up just as the rockets failed.
